title: Timucua language - Wikipedia
text: Timucua is a language isolate formerly spoken in northern and central Florida and southern Georgia by the Timucua peoples. Timucua was the primary language used in the area at the time of Spanish colonization in Florida.

title: Timucua language
text: The Timucua language was an extinct Native American language isolate spoken by the Timucua people across northern Florida and southern Georgia from prehistoric times until its extinction in the mid-18th century, following the deportation of the last communities to Cuba around 1763.
